Sails.js staging environment configuration that extends the production config (`config/env/production.js`) with staging-specific overrides.

## Key Components

| Setting | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `datastores.default` | (commented out) | Override for staging database URL |
| `sockets.onlyAllowOrigins` | `https://staging.fleetdm.com` | Restricts WebSocket connections to staging origin |
| `sockets.url` | (commented out) | Override for staging Redis socket server |
| `session.url` | (commented out) | Override for staging Redis session store |
| `custom.baseUrl` | `https://staging.fleetdm.com` | Base URL for staging environment |
| `custom.internalEmailAddress` | `support+staging@example.com` | Internal email recipient for staging contact forms |

## Usage Example

Lift the app in staging mode by setting both `NODE_ENV` and `sails_environment`:

```bash
NODE_ENV=production sails_environment=staging node app
```

Override sensitive values via system environment variables instead of hard-coding:

```bash
export sails_datastores__default__url="mysql://user:pass@db.example.com:3306/staging_db"
export sails_sockets__url="redis://user:pass@redis.example.com:9562/"
export sails_session__url="redis://user:pass@redis.example.com:9562/staging-sessions"
export sails_custom__baseUrl="https://staging.fleetdm.com"
```

> **Note:** `NODE_ENV` must remain `"production"` even in staging. Only `sails_environment=staging` switches this config file into effect.
